name: Freelancers and late invoices
description: Six fictional interviews with solo freelancers about getting paid. Mixed formats: markdown, timestamped text, Q&A and founder notes.
product_idea: A tool that helps freelancers get paid on time.

hypotheses.text: Freelancers struggle to chase late invoices.
Freelancers would pay for a tool that sends automated payment reminders.
Creating invoices is time-consuming for freelancers.
Freelancers want to accept payments in cryptocurrency.
